para.emphasis: PART 7 — CREATE ONE PROCUREMENT PLAN WITH MULTIPLE REQUIREMENTS

chapter.para: This is where you test your requirement that:

para.emphasis: One department can have multiple procurements.

chapter.para: Login as: John — User Department Officer
Description: Supply of business laptops for academic and administrative staff
Description: Supply of desktop computers for ICT laboratories
Description: Supply and installation of managed network switches, wireless access points and related network equipment
Description: Supply of ergonomic office chairs for ICT staff

This is also an important real-world concept: requirements should be planned rationally and aggregated where appropriate, rather than artificially splitting procurement to avoid the appropriate method.
therefore, do not create four separate plans simply because you want four procurements. One plan can contain many planned requirements.
Now we are ready to create individual procurement requisitions.
We will create three different procurement cases.
The purpose is to exercise your Micro path.
